ctaHeading: Ready to transform your Coburg bathroom?
aboutText: With over 30 years of experience, Bathroom Renovations Coburg has been transforming bathrooms across Coburg and Melbourne's northern suburbs. Our team of in-house tradespeople delivers every project with a fixed-price guarantee, ensuring no surprises on your invoice. From small touch-ups to full bathroom remodels, we handle everything under one contact — so you can relax while we bring your dream bathroom to life.
servicesText: We offer end-to-end bathroom renovations in Coburg with in-house tradespeople at every stage. From demolition to tiling, plumbing to waterproofing — one contact manages your entire project with our fixed-price guarantee.

services.title: Complete Bathroom Renovations
services.desc: Full bathroom strip-out and rebuild handled entirely by our in-house team from start to finish.

services.title: Shower & Bath Installations
services.desc: Expert installation of showers, bathtubs, and freestanding baths with quality fixtures and fittings.

services.title: Tiling & Waterproofing
services.desc: Precision tiling and certified waterproofing by experienced tradespeople for a lasting finish.

services.title: Plumbing & Electrical
services.desc: Licensed plumbers and electricians on our team ensure every connection is safe and compliant.

services.title: Vanity & Storage Solutions
services.desc: Custom vanities, cabinetry, and smart storage designed to maximise your bathroom space.

services.title: Design & Consultation
services.desc: Personalised guidance on tiles, layouts, and finishes tailored to your style and budget.
